documents.content: approval_token_alpha: High-risk file writes require approval for exact tool arguments. Approval is scoped to one action and cannot authorize a different path.
checkpoint_token_beta: A checkpoint persists run state, usage budgets, pending approval, and the next deterministic step. Resume prevents duplicate tool execution.
context_token_gamma: ContextCompiler allocates separate token budgets to instructions, recent messages, repository evidence, tools, memory, and observations.
retrieval_token_delta: Hybrid retrieval combines SQLite FTS5 lexical hits and Qdrant vector hits with reciprocal rank fusion before BGE reranking.
memory_token_epsilon: Long-term memory starts as a candidate. Only human-approved memory is embedded into a collection separate from the knowledge base.
trace_token_zeta: Every model decision and tool effect is appended to a hash-chained JSONL trace. Verification detects mutation or event deletion.
intent_token_eta: The router selects knowledge_query, coding_task, memory_command, or general_chat. Invalid structured model output falls back to deterministic rules.
vision_token_theta: PNG and JPEG uploads are bounded to ten MiB. The local vision model extracts observable text and structure into a citable derived chunk.
reviewer_token_iota: Reviewer Agent is read-only and validates citation source, chunk id, quote, page, and line location. It has no shell or write tools.
platform_token_kappa: FastAPI instances run on the macOS host. Nginx balances them while PostgreSQL, Redis, and Qdrant run in Docker Compose.
